title: The full sweep finishes under four minutes on a quiet machine: decisions are tested directly and real git is kept for the git contract
description: Owner decision 2026-10-30. P143.8 and P143.10 measured the sweep throughput-bound (about 2500 slot-seconds over 8 workers, 325-327 s quiet on darwin) with about 84% of the drive suite's time in process spawn; per-call git memoisation gave about 2% each and is exhausted. Most cases in tests/test_drive_phase.py, test_commit_task_work.py, test_audit_task.py and test_close_phase.py reach a decision through a real repository and real verbs although only the decision is under test. First measure: classify every case as decision-logic (git is scenery) or git-contract, with slot-seconds per class. Then convert the decision-logic cases suite by suite to call the pure decision functions on built state, keeping a small deliberate end-to-end set. Never re-record .github/sweep-costs.json from darwin.
desiredOutcome: python3 tools/sweep-selftests.py finishes under 240 s wall on the owner's machine, quiet, twice at least 20 minutes apart; every converted case still goes red on the defect it guards; the end-to-end set names what each case proves about git.

tasks.title: Per-verb git reads are memoised on the bytes git itself reads
tasks.description: Plan: quality-gates-internal plans/2026-10-31-speed-phase/PLAN.md section 4, P152.6. Memoise resolve_author (usage_ledger.py), _git_config_origins (_panel_viewer.py), current_branch (_id_shape.py) and _worktree_key_uncached (_journal_io.py, through _config.git_place) on a witness made of the files git reads (HEAD, config files), never a timer. Red-first in both directions for every memo: a memo that never invalidates goes red, a memo that is never used goes red. _deps.py GIT_PATH_BASE_EXEMPT rows follow any git call that moves. PLUGIN-BUILD-GUIDE.md sections of each touched module.

add: tests/test__id_shape.py: each memoised read is re-asked after the witness file changes and is not re-asked while it is unchanged

add: tests/test__machine_paths.py: a shape whose needles are stripped from a line no longer fires; check-committed-pii pi-domain: prefilter rows equal unfiltered rows over the real domain

tasks.title: The dependency lints index each scope, module and file once
tasks.description: Plan: quality-gates-internal plans/2026-10-31-speed-phase/PLAN.md section 4, P152.9. No lint changes its answer. Cases: each index equals a recomputation on a fixture module with a poisoned entry; _name_normalisers still answers the ck3 pair. prove-gates row ck3's anchor follows its line.

add: tests/test__deps.py: each per-scope, per-module and per-file index equals a recomputation over a fixture module with a poisoned entry

tasks.title: Each file is parsed once per process for the tree lints and the gate prover, keyed on its content
tasks.description: Plan: quality-gates-internal plans/2026-10-31-speed-phase/PLAN.md section 4, P152.10. _output_lints.parsed_sources(dirs) returns [(rel, path, src, tree)] memoised on (path, sha256(bytes)) - content, never mtime and size, because prove-gates mutates and restores inside one process. The fifteen _output_lints parse sites and prove-gates _gate_sources read it; parsed_sources gets a NOT_A_GATE row. Cases: a rewritten file re-parses, an identical rewrite does not, a poisoned tree is nobody else's. Optional test-side _tree_answer memo. Every prove-gates anchor quoting an ast.parse line is re-pointed; the whole prove-gates table runs once.

add: tests/test__output_lints.py: parsed_sources re-parses a rewritten file, does not re-parse an identical rewrite, and keeps one tree's poison out of another
